_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); hotel signals

pit_profile.why: Marriott: 'Consistent with our focus on management, franchising, and licensing, we own or lease very few of our lodging properties (less than one percent of our system)'; 'We are a worldwide operator, franchisor, and licensor of hotel, residential, timeshare, and other lodging properties in 139 countries and territories under more than 30 brand names'; 'Our industry is highly competitive, which may impact our ability to compete successfully for guests'; 'Our hotel brands and other lodging offerings generally compete with major hotel chains, regional hotel chains, independent hotels, and home sharing and rental services across national and international venues'; 'Economic and other global, national, and regional conditions and events have in the past impacted, and could in the future impact, our business, financial results and growth'; 'An increase in the use of third-party Internet services to book online hotel reservations could adversely impact our business' (its own FY2023 10-K): a hotel management and franchise system whose fees follow the revenues and profits of its hotels through the economy, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Marriott: 'Consistent with our focus on management, franchising, and licensing, we own or lease very few of our lodging properties (less than one percent of our system)'; 'We are a worldwide operator, franchisor, and licensor of hotel, residential, timeshare, and other lodging properties in 139 countries and territories under more than 30 brand names'; 'Our industry is highly competitive, which may impact our ability to compete successfully for guests'; 'Our hotel brands and other lodging offerings generally compete with major hotel chains, regional hotel chains, independent hotels, and home sharing and rental services across national and international venues'; 'Economic and other global, national, and regional conditions and events have in the past impacted, and could in the future impact, our business, financial results and growth'; 'An increase in the use of third-party Internet services to book online hotel reservations could adversely impact our business' (its own FY2023 10-K): a hotel management and franchise system whose fees follow the revenues and profits of its hotels through the economy, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.83x; +15% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.43; conservative 2yr +16%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -29.4%/yr (worst year FY14-FY23 ex-FY20, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +6.9%/yr (Q3 fee guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY20 median

BULL.desc: EPS +16.7%/yr (FY14-FY23 ex-FY20 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +74.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY14-FY23 ex-FY20); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MAR (retrospective, 2024-08-23) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 0.83x (59.2% downside to Bear $92 / +70.9% upside to Bull $385) | Adj composite 2.50 vs market 2.07: gap +0.43 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | +15% above the EPP floor $196 (21x FY24E $9.31) | Conservative 2-yr case: +16.1% total (+8.1%/yr) | At 24.2x FY24E the 15% hurdle price $298 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; North American RevPAR +3.7% in Q2 2024, forward fee revenue +6.52-7.77% (Q3 2024 fee revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
